fields.description: This branch's own cap on the customer's exposure (unbilled Sales Orders + unpaid Sales Invoices raised at this branch). Leave 0 to not cap this branch on its own -- it can then draw on the full company-wide Credit Limit. Every branch's non-zero Credit Limit here must sum to no more than the customer's own company-wide Credit Limit (enforced on save).
fields.label: Credit Limit
